jobs.title: JAVA Course OOP
jobs.description: Learn object-oriented programming with Java through a hands-on, project-based course designed for beginners and early developers.
jobs.aboutRole: This course walks you from Java fundamentals to core OOP principles. You will practise with guided exercises and build small projects with feedback from experienced TOMEX instructors.
responsibilities: Attend the live online sessions and complete weekly exercises
Build and present a small Java project using OOP principles
Participate in code reviews and apply the feedback
Keep a consistent learning pace and ask questions early

jobs.title: Front End Developer HTML/CSS/JAVASCRIPT
jobs.description: Build modern, responsive websites from scratch in this practical front-end course covering HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
jobs.aboutRole: You will learn how to structure pages with semantic HTML, style them with modern CSS and add interactivity with JavaScript, finishing with a portfolio-ready website.
responsibilities: Attend the live online sessions and complete practical assignments
Build responsive layouts that work on mobile and desktop
Publish a final project and present it to the group
